title: Page 116
transc:
Washington May 9 1864
R OBrien
Jamestown
Julia may padlock for Knox unity a despatch from
Jupiter has just been read zebra he is on
the march with his whole opal to form a
steuben with you but had not determined his rout
another despatch from him is being translated Walrus Brutus
Eckert


War Dep't Wash'n May 9 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Growl Rosetta may pony to pandora Biggs vincent animal
we need wayworn power to tow barges and schooner 
with supplies and horses we have also about plank
promise person publish to pebble purple spit to send
to waylay Knave among them a veteran whip of
nuptial send weasel tow boats and also weaselers to
whimper these men up Bergen do this immediately Bender
Thos T. Eckert


Washington May 10 1864
R OBrien Bermuda Landing 
Your penfields come here with out being
timed and with very important words open
Unity the arbitrary words should be used
when at all possible and the time
should never be left out Zebra be
very careful in punctuation please notice end
TT Eckert
